draft_en.subject: A neutral-brand equivalent to the Wi-Tek switches you wholesale
draft_en.body:
Hello AV Nordic team,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "24 Port PoE Managed Switch" on 21 August 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the Wi-Tek switches you wholesale with Uniview and Milesight, neutral-brand equivalents from small lots, CE/RoHS: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD EXW at distributor price (MOQ 1, 15-day validity); budget 8-PoE + 2 uplink unmanaged - STC-028GP - $25.1.

One question: which Wi-Tek model turns fastest for your installers, so we quote its equivalent first?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
